title: Uninstall and backup: managed outputs removed cleanly, user content untouched
prerequisites: Node.js >= 18 and the make-docs CLI built from this repository.
A fresh disposable fixture workspace; the scenario never touches a maintainer working tree. This scenario owns the PRD 36 R-PROV-2 cleanliness proof at the real-harness layer.
Command steps below are rendered for the Codex first-pass target binding; projecting them for another bound target is owned by kit generation (PRD 43 R-KIT-1), never by hand-editing this definition.

steps.notes: Disposable fixture workspace (workspacePolicy); all later steps run inside it.

Installs Make Docs into the disposable workspace: `package write` refuses installed outputs without a Make Docs manifest, and the uninstall stage's `setup remove` and `setup backup` presuppose a real install (register item D-023: precondition establishment is a workspace-setup step, never remembered mid-session; this missing step was surfaced by the W18 R13 P2 kit generator's executable-by-construction dry-run).

steps.run: mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/docs/assets/playbooks/agent" && cp conformance/fixtures/agent/conformance-skill-probe.playbook.md "$WORKSPACE/docs/assets/playbooks/agent/" && printf 'user-authored sentinel\n' > "$WORKSPACE/docs/assets/playbooks/agent/user-authored-note.md" && printf 'user-authored sentinel\n' > "$WORKSPACE/USER-NOTES.md"
steps.notes: User-authored sentinel files sit beside and inside directories the packaging writers manage, so deletion or orphaning is detectable.

steps.run:
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/.make-docs" && printf 'packaging:
  preconditions:
    harness-supported: satisfied
    project-trusted: satisfied
    symlink-or-copy-mirror: satisfied
' > "$WORKSPACE/.make-docs/config.yaml"
steps.notes: Establishes the packaging precondition attestations both ship steps consume (register item D-023: attestations are supplied by the session's workspace setup, never remembered mid-session; the operator attests the disposable workspace is trusted and the adapter preconditions hold).

steps.run: cd "$WORKSPACE" && make-docs run package ship --harness codex --output-kind plugin --surface native --scope project --package-id conformance-plugin-probe --support-evidence-ref conformance/tuple-registry.json#codex-plugin-native-project --json agent/conformance-skill-probe
steps.notes: The evidence ref names the exact registry tuple this session's evidence lands on (D-023: the planner hard-stops without one).

steps.run: cd "$WORKSPACE" && make-docs run package ship --harness codex --output-kind skills-bundle --surface native --scope project --package-id conformance-skill-probe --support-evidence-ref conformance/tuple-registry.json#codex-skills-bundle-native-project --json agent/conformance-skill-probe
steps.notes: Both container kinds are installed so uninstall cleanliness is proven across the plugin tree, the skills bundle, and their exposure links in one workspace.

steps.run: cd "$WORKSPACE" && git add -A && git -c user.email=probe@example.invalid -c user.name=probe commit -m baseline
steps.notes: The committed baseline makes the post-uninstall user-content diff byte-exact.

steps.action: Launch the target harness inside the workspace and confirm both generated outputs appear in the harness's listing surfaces.
In a fresh harness thread, invoke the bundled probe skill once, confirming the installed outputs are live before removal.

steps.notes: The backup half of the R-PROV-2 cleanliness pair. --yes carries the backup confirmation for the non-TTY run (D-023: the TTY confirmation gate refuses a non-TTY run without it).

steps.assert: The backup snapshot exists under the workspace backup location, captures the managed state, and did not move, rewrite, or delete any user-authored file.

steps.notes: --yes carries the uninstall confirmation for the non-TTY run (D-023: the TTY confirmation gate refuses a non-TTY run without it).

steps.assert: After removal every managed generated output is gone — the plugin tree, the skills bundle, exposure links, and the generated marketplace entry — and no empty managed directory is orphaned under .codex/plugins/, .agents/, or the skills roots.

git status against the committed baseline shows the user-authored sentinel files (USER-NOTES.md and docs/assets/playbooks/agent/user-authored-note.md) and the fixture Playbook byte-identical: uninstall and backup deleted no user-authored file.

expectedEvidence: Two --json ship transcripts recording the installed plugin and skills bundle (install).
Both outputs visible in the target harness's listing surfaces (discover).
A fresh-thread invocation transcript proving the outputs were live before removal (invoke).

Non-TTY backup and removal transcripts plus a git diff against the committed baseline proving managed outputs removed, no orphaned empty managed directories, and user-authored files byte-identical (uninstall).
Model, provider, and runtime captured as run metadata in the result record.

install: Both ship commands exit 0 with --json transcripts recording the generated plugin tree and skills bundle with their ownership records.
discover: Both generated outputs appear in the target harness's own listing surfaces for the workspace.
invoke: A fresh harness thread invokes the bundled probe skill before removal, proving the outputs under test were live.
uninstall: make-docs setup backup --yes snapshots the managed state without touching user-authored files.
make-docs setup remove --backup --yes removes every managed generated output without orphaning an empty managed directory.
The git diff against the committed baseline shows all user-authored sentinel files byte-identical (PRD 36 R-PROV-2).

preconditions.description: The target harness CLI is installed and on PATH; the concrete probe command lives on each target binding.
The target harness CLI is signed in with a working account; the concrete probe command lives on each target binding.
Outbound network access for the harness is available; attested by the operator at run time because probing it would spend it.
The harness can route to a model for the invoke stage; attested by the operator at run time.
